beats.title: pictures of the girls over music

beats.text: That's a really nice necklace you have there! Where'd you get it from?
Oh, Sonic got it for me
??? What's wrong? Don't you like it?
Hi, girls! *walking towards them*
Hey Tikal
Amy, are you ok?
I complimented her about her necklace that Sonic got her and then she got a little sad
I'm not sad!
The necklace? Amy, you got upset about it yesterday so something's up
I do love it! It's just.. *sigh*
Just what?
He got it from Chaos Jewerlly
Whoa! Then that must've cost a lot
Exactly.. and all that I got him was..
*sigh* a red basketball shirt saying his name on with number 01
Amy! That's the perfect gift for Sonic!
but it didn't cost as much...
Are you mad? Sonic's gonna love it! It doesn't matter how much it costed!
It didn't really cost anything cause I made it..
Aw Amy it will be perfect for Sonic, we both promise you that
Thanks, girls... it means a lot
Hey, girls! *walking towards them in a crowd*
Um, do we know any of you?
No, but we know you! So do any of you sexy girls wanna go to the prom with me!
PROM?!
Yeah so do any of you wanna go with me?
Ignore him, he's basic. I'm hot stuff for any of you *smirk*
Listen, we didn't even knew there was gonna be Prom but we-
Well now you know. And today is your lucky day cause you get to be with-
*pushes him out the way* Me *walking towards Tikal*
Can I have some space please? *walking backwards*
I like purple, it goes very well with my type *grabs Blaze*
Don't you dare touch me! *kicks him away*
We're only asking to prom, no need to get smoked!
What about you, hot stuff? *walking towards Amy*
Listen, pal. I have, a b-
Don't worry, I know you need someone to go with you. That's why I'm here
Stay back!
What? You're the one leaning against the wall so-
HEY PUNKS! LEAVE THOSE GIRLS ALONE!
ESPECIALLY MINE!
